gen-gf-walter-turncoat-rubik: Relaxed copper-pipe letters in Walter Turncoat, casual pen-and-paper, shallow extenders. Rubik holds a sans-serif column, while Walter Turncoat belongs in a short shout of large letters.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-saira: Saira shows a gap in each s, rounded letters stretching high toward the top line, clean and easy. Oxanium does the short shout; Saira does the long line.
gen-gf-zen-loop-fs-bespoke-sans: Generous gaps at the stems give Bespoke Sans a sharp, refined read. And Bespoke Sans prefers a smaller size under Zen Loop, whose c forms never read as closed rings.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-orienta: Clear channels into every round letter: Autour One, one-width, cases almost matching, expressive and bold. Orienta stands under that display, reed-cut counters and matching cases throughout.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-parkinsans: Spaghetti-like, same-width strokes mark Funnel Display, c tips never meeting at all. And Parkinsans holds a stretch of sans-serif copy, one thickness everywhere, wide mouths staying crisp.
gen-metal-mania-archivo: Archivo opens curves outward under a commanding x-height, editorial and approachable. And Metal Mania packs a dense paperclip stripe above that sans-serif, large eyes in every e.
gen-metal-mania-fs-asap: Metal Mania packs a dense paperclip stripe, a large eye on every e. And Asap holds a stretch of plain sans, open-arc c forms, bodies nearly matching the caps.
gen-metal-mania-manrope: Manrope keeps a bright gap at every curved mouth, one-width strokes, cases almost matching. Manrope holds a plain sans column, while Metal Mania belongs in a short shout of large letters.
gen-metal-mania-satoshi: Satoshi soars in x-height, an e that never looks squeezed. Metal Mania packs a dense stripe above; Satoshi holds a stretch of plain sans, strokes cut from one gauge.
gen-modak-fs-merriweather-sans: Modak never swells or thins, washer-big eyes, a c that stays far from closing. And Merriweather Sans holds the sans column, while Modak belongs in a short shout of large letters.
gen-nixie-one-gf-julius-sans-one: Nostalgic open curves with clear gaps mark Nixie One, a constant stroke from top to baseline. Julius Sans One holds the sans column, while Nixie One stays large and brief.
gen-nixie-one-gf-lexend-tera: Retro-tech constant strokes with open curves: Nixie One, nostalgic and clear. Lexend Tera prefers a smaller size, a sans-serif with plotter-pen lines and letters like stepping stones.
gen-nosifer-archivo: Archivo keeps an editorial line with outward curves and a commanding x-height, approachable in a column. Nosifer pinches its mouths shut; that plain sans keeps going.
gen-nosifer-fs-fira-sans: Nosifer tracks widely, pinched mouths like sealed flaps, crayon-high lowercase, dark and commanding. Fira Sans holds a stretch of sans-serif copy, wide-open s curves, zero thick-thin contrast.
gen-nosifer-fs-merriweather-sans: Pinched mouths like sealed envelope flaps mark Nosifer, widely tracked and dark. Merriweather Sans, made large, still looks sturdy while those pinched mouths would smear shut.
